description: Open a simple local browser page so the user can send NGT on Base from their own wallet to the assistant's spending address. Nothing moves unless they confirm; this tool never sees their personal keys. Only call after the user has agreed to the amount (capped by NGT_MAX_FUNDING). Afterwards, call ngt_wallet_status to see whether it arrived.

amount_ngt.description: NGT to request, for example "0.1". At most 10 NGT.

name: fund_agent_wallet
title: Fund Agent Wallet [opens the user's browser wallet]
